Done! I've added `src/routes/posts.js` to the repo with a `postPath(title)` function that:

- Takes a post title as input
- Converts it to a URL-safe slug using the existing `slugify` utility (matching the app's canonical slug rules)
- Returns the path as `/posts/{slug}`

This follows the exact same pattern as the existing `userPath` function in `src/routes/users.js`, ensuring consistency across the codebase. The `slugify` utility normalizes accents, converts `&` to `and`, collapses other non-alphanumeric characters to hyphens, and removes leading/trailing hyphens.
